mentions.name: iup-go (IUP fork)
mentions.description: Cross-platform UI library fork of IUP offering native controls, packaged for Go. Adds multiple drivers/backends (Cocoa, WinUI, Qt, GTK4, FLTK, EFL), new controls such as Table, Popover, SWITCH toggle, and modern tray support, a WebBrowser control using modern browsers with a JAVASCRIPT attribute for hybrid native/web apps, and an EGL-based GLCanvas for X11 and Wayland with proper Wayland support across Linux toolkits.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working for several months (maybe half a year) on the IUP fork, a cross-platform UI library with native controls https://github.com/gen2brain/iup-go .
